description: Look up which sign-in methods are registered for a given email address by querying the identity backend. The request carries the email to look up and the canned backend response for the lookup endpoint. On a successful lookup the backend returns the list of provider identifiers associated with the address, and the client surfaces that list. When the backend rejects the lookup with an invalid-identifier failure (for example when the supplied identifier is empty or malformed), the client raises a normalized domain error whose category is reported instead of the provider list.
